name: Should I replace or reface my kitchen cabinets during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace or reface my kitchen cabinets during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to replace or reface cabinets depends on their existing condition, your budget, and desired outcome. Refacing is a more cost-effective option if the cabinet boxes are structurally sound and you're happy with the current layout; it involves updating doors, drawer fronts, and veneers. Replacing cabinets is recommended if the boxes are damaged, you want to change the layout, or desire a completely new look and functionality. Full replacement offers more design flexibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Refacing saves money if cabinet boxes are sound and you like the layout. Replace cabinets for layout changes, damage, or a completely new look and functionality.
